root_idea.summary: The root centers on a gap, cleft, or opening, and on the separation produced when one thing is set apart from others.
root_idea.development: From the sense of an interstice or breach, the root develops toward particularity, distinction, exclusive assignment, and special favor; the same image extends figuratively to poverty as a deficient or weakened condition.

senses.definition: To single out or specially favor someone, assigning or appropriating a specified thing exclusively to them; to distinguish one from others in this way.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction is اِخْتَصَّ بِـ, with a person singled out by or for a special favor; the attested object is divine mercy, bestowed on whom God wills.

senses.definition: Exclusively; specifically or particularly, as opposed to generally.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adverbially to mark that a restriction is not confined to the specified group; in the Quranic usage, the warning is not limited to the wrongdoers mentioned.
The Quranic use describes a state of want or insufficient means, even while giving preference to others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To distinguish, favor, or single out someone or something by a quality or allotment; to appropriate it exclusively to a person; or to choose someone as one's exclusive associate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive constructions commonly use بِـ or لِـ; partiality and preferential treatment are included in this branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone something in large quantity or abundantly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended transitive use with بِـ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To specify, mention, point to, or except someone or something in particular from a larger whole.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes constructions meaning to single out by mention and to distinguish or except something from what is general.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become particular, restricted, or exclusive rather than general; to belong or pertain exclusively to someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use, also occurring with expressions meaning that something belongs particularly or exclusively to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become poor or to be in a state of poverty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended intransitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something particular, distinct, or special; to particularize it or single it out from what is general.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived Form II meaning contrasts with generalization or making something universal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become particular, specialized, or non-general.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or quasi-passive development of the act of making something particular.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be in an isolated state of pressing want and poverty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended usage describing a peculiar, unshared condition of severe need.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A booth or hut made of reeds, canes, or branches; also a similar structure or a vintner's shop.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is associated with the openings or narrow interstices visible in such a structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Particularity, peculiarity, or specialty; particularly or specially.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the state of being particular, while its adverbial use means particularly or specially.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An interstice, gap, interval, crevice, or opening; a small hole or perforation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may denote intervening spaces or openings in structures, objects, or between adjacent things.
A separate lexical use attested alongside the gap or opening sense.
A figurative extension for the condition of returning from water or food without having had enough.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Particular, peculiar, special, or distinct rather than general; by extension, choice or select.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective contrasts with generality and may describe what is selected or set apart.
A distinct adjectival use describing something free from admixture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: As a substantive, a distinguished person or member of the elite.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used collectively or substantively in contrast with the common people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A specially chosen or intimate friend, companion, associate, attendant, dependent, or servant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may function substantively for a person appropriated or chosen as someone's special associate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A peculiar property or characteristic of a thing; technically, a special efficacy or property associated with a known effect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical use for an effective property, whether or not the cause of its effect is known.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A little or specially chosen friend, companion, attendant, or servant; in idiomatic use, one's particular state or specially appointed end.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The diminutive can convey smallness, affection, or awe; traditional expressions also use it for one's personal condition or individually appointed fate.

cautions: The Quranic Form VIII verb is presented under the normalized perfect citation اِخْتَصَّ, although the supplied Quran occurrences are the imperfect يَخْتَصُّ.
The technical sense of خَاصَّةٌ as a peculiar property or efficacy is identified in the evidence as possibly post-classical.
